text:
maria: Opening a tiny PR to replace verbose function-calling examples with compact envelopes + an appendix. Will also patch a broken link in the schema section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402
drew: Nice. Please ensure we keep one full example somewhere for debugging. Compact is better for quickstarts though.
zack: Agree. Also check snippets/python/invoke.md, snippets/js/invoke.md — both reference old shape `tool_call`. Runtime now uses `invocation` in some models.
maria: Good catch. Plan: canonical examples will use `invocation` and a parenthetical note: "legacy SDKs may show `tool_call`". I will update snippets in same PR.
docs-bot: Reminder: add CHANGELOG entry and mark PR as docs-only to skip release gating.
drew: For the snippet fallback show this pattern: try compact -> else raw_text -> best-effort parse. Short code example is enough.
evie: Also found a dead anchor from the migration guide to the JSON-schema appendix. Please include that fix too.
maria: I'll add a cross-link from docs/migration/structured-output.md to the appendix and the compact quickstart.
zack: Ops request: don't modify public API examples without an explicit compatibility blurb at top.
maria: Will add a header note calling out compatibility.
docs-bot: Suggest adding a small grep test in docs CI to ensure invoke snippets include `compact` or `raw_text`. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/223344556
drew: Fine with that. If CI test is simple, ops will approve.
maria: PR will include link fixes, snippet updates, changelog, and the CI lint. Requesting reviews from @drew and @zack.
drew: Reviewing after standup.
evie: I'll sweep for other `tool_call` mentions after your push.
maria: Pushed. Title: "docs: compact invoke envelopes + appendix + migration links"
docs-bot: PR 1402 updated: link fix pushed, snippets modified, changelog added.
